title: Changelog - October 2025
content:
## Changelog - October 2025


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000106574

New Features:

- Created a new Membership Plan setting called "Verify Listing" to control the display of the Verified Member Link on the Member Dashboard. The previous "Verify Listing" Advanced Setting has been deprecated.

- Added new search filters and sort options to the Web Page Builder page in the Admin.

- Added new Design Settings for the Discussions Recent Widget: "Enable Carousel Slider?" and "Hide on Mobile" These settings allow enabling the carousel slider and hiding the section on mobile devices for the "Recent Discussions" homepage section.

- Released the new AI Newsletter Creator to enhance the workflow of creating Email Templates in the Admin.

- Created a new Review Setting called "Make 'Email' and 'Name' Fields Readonly". When enabled, the Email and Name fields on the Reviews form will be set as "readonly", making their values uneditable once populated automatically.

- Released the new "Create Web Page Wizard". To use this new feature navigate to the Admin >> Quick Create button >> Create Web Page.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- Fixed an issue that caused public form submissions to get stuck on the "Processing Request..." message in some cases.

- Added the Item Schema List for Single Image Posts, Multi-Photo Posts, Reviews, and Member Search Result pages on the frontend.

- Added new Design Settings called "Menu Font Weight" and "Dropdown Font Weight" to control the font weight of the main menu and dropdown menu items on the frontend.

- The Referral Input form field on checkout pages is now compatible with the "Required Field?" form field setting.

- Added the "System Name" of menus next to the "Menu Name" in the dropdown values for the "Public Visitor Main Menu" and "Logged-In Member Main Menu" Design Settings in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue that affected the display of the Member Upgrade page on the Member Dashboard when using mobile devices.

- Fixed an issue that was causing the system to display the the "Showing 1 to 47 of 47 entries" info twice on the SEO Templates page in the Admin.

- Updated the text that displays in the modal when purchasing Pay Per Post in the Member Dashboard.

- Updated the General Settings dropdowns to display "(Default)" for the default value of each setting.

- Added the ability to sort the content of the Top and Sub Categories Recent Homepage sections by category ID.

- The "Donation Payment Type" module on the Digital Products Details page is now compatible with Text Labels.

- Updated the "Default Member Search URL" validation setting on the General Settings page in the Admin.

- Updated the "Include Website Logo" Email Template setting to "Include Default Template w/Logo". Added options to display the website logo at the Top, Center, Right, or choose to send emails with no template or logo.

- Added Omani (OMR) currency as a supported Website Currency.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Website URL form field validation from working properly on the frontend in some cases.

- Updated the Stripe payment gateway integration workflows for 3D Secure credit cards.

- Fixed an issue that affected the ability to update the status of reviews on the Member Reviews page in the Admin in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "View Setting" link for the Require Complete Profile setting on the General Settings page from showing the Advanced Setting directly.

- Fixed an issue that caused the system to charge the incorrect amount when using the Quick Create action buttons in the Admin in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented member upgrades from working properly when a member did not have a credit card on file, specifically when using Stripe as the payment gateway and the "Use AVS Billing Address Fields" Advanced Setting was active.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the schema m arkup on post detail pages from working properly when the post title contained double quotes.

- Added the "Create Newsletter" button to the "What do you want to do today" module on the Dashboard page in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue with removing the post types to search when editing autosuggest rules on the "Keyword Autosuggest Rules" page in the Admin in some cases.

- Added new search filters and sort options to the Form Manager page in the Admin.

- Fixed an issue that affected the ability for members to remove the credit card on file in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Member Reviews page in the Member Dashboard from loading properly in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that affected the alignment of the Summary and Promo Box modules when viewing checkout pages on mobile devices.

- Added the "Default" value for all settings on the Advanced Settings page in the Admin.

- Updated the Membership Plan keyword search in the Admin to include the ability to search by Membership Plan ID.

- Fixed an issue that caused the system to display an error message after submitting post forms in the Member Dashboard when the expired post workaround was active and the "Date Format" setting was set to "YYYY/MM/DD".

- Updated all default schema widgets to be compatible with the "Front-End Optimization: Use Content Delivery Network (CDN) for Images" Advanced Setting.

- Fixed an issue that affected the ability to disable the "Slide 1" image when the Homepage Background Slider Add-On is active on the homepage of a website.

- Added the ability to sort Smart List results by creation date on the "Smart Lists & Tags" page in the Admin.

- Updated the Froala Text Editor form fields to support the "Placeholder Text" Form Field Setting.

- Fixed an issue where deleting Top Level categories from the Member Categories page in the Admin leaving “orphaned” Sub Level categories even when the option to delete all Sub Level categories was selected.

- Added tracking for spam submissions on checkout pages to the Activity Tracker.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Follow Comments" feature on post details pages from working properly in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Enable Right-to-Left CSS Layout Adjustment" Advanced Setting from working properly on email and password form fields.

- Updated the Stripe payment gateway integration workflows for 3D Secure credit cards.

- Updated the Reviews API endpoint to make the review_description field optional when creating new reviews via the API.

- Implemented a performance update to the Google Maps integration to ensure compatibility with the "Front-End Optimization: Only Load Google Maps When Requested by User" Advanced Setting when the "Enable New Google Maps Places API" setting is active.

- Updated the /get endpoints of the API to automatically apply a default limit of 100 to the results when no limit is specified in the request.

- Fixed an issue that was causing the system to hide a website's header when a member added a new credit card on file in the Member Dashboard.

- The Billing Cycle options shown when a member changes their Membership Plan from the Member Dashboard are now compatible with Text Labels.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the system from respecting the Maximum Matches and Maximum Accepted Matches Lead Settings when auto-matching leads to members in some cases.

- Fixed an issue that caused the system to apply a member's credits to a Digital Products purchase when the "MEMBER CREDITS: Enable Credit System" Advanced Setting was disabled when using Razorpay as the Payment Gateway.

- Updated the " Create Static Page " Frontend Admin Menu item to "Add Custom Content" . Also, clicking the "Add Custom Content" link now automatically opens the new "Create Web Page Wizard" modal.

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Import Post via CSV functionality from importing data accurately when not all fields in the import file were filled in some cases.

- In all, over 60 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
